rationale: The diff 8b3a5535..e7388f71 introduces no defect in my lens. Skipping empty and non-SHA reviewed values does not reopen any of my stale-round shapes. In each one, the later unlanded round B is recorded as a real rev-parse SHA (class c), so it is still evaluated and refuses. Turning B into a skipped value requires rewriting the registration file, which is exactly the already-stated panel-edit forge residual, not a new reach. A gc'd SHA counting as outside-tip closes the one way a real B could otherwise dodge the check through an F5 error. The amend-after-panel fail-closed (vii-a) and the per-checkout visibility statement are consistent with my round-6 analysis.

findings.title: Value classes do not reopen stale-round shapes
findings.detail: Shapes {1:A,2:B}, single-dir {2:B}, cross-dir {3:A,2:B} and amended/reset variants all carry B as a well-formed object ID, so B is class (c), evaluated, and REFUSES (outside the tip, or gc'd, which is outside by definition). Empty (a) means no fan-out ever ran, so there is no reviewed work to lose. A placeholder (b) such as 'design-review-no-code' names no commit. Moving a real B into (a) or (b) requires editing panel.json, which is the stated F2 forge residual (AC-11 ix-g). The one widening worth noting: ref-like text without revision characters (e.g. 'bead/x') or an under-7-hex abbreviation now classifies as a placeholder (skipped) rather than malformed (fail closed). The panel tooling writes full rev-parse output, so this changes nothing in practice.

findings.title: Per-checkout visibility is stated honestly
findings.detail: F2 passing from a checkout without the untracked reviews/ is now explicit, pinned (x-w), and the output names the scanned roots and advises running from the spec worktree. This is within the visibility residual I raised in round 4.

findings.detail: None found. The Round-7 summary matches the diff (value classes in R4.3 and F2, gc'd-as-outside, per-checkout visibility, AC-11 vii-a, typed ErrPathNotAtRef probe, repo counts dropped, residual wording).
